_comment: Local CI config for Fyrn (BNB-TOOLS T28). Run with: sh ci/check.sh
_suite_command: ci/run_suite.sh picks the shared venv Python and the extracted Qt libraries when they exist (the sandbox), and falls back to plain python3 anywhere else.
_suite_timeout: The suite takes 150-200s when the sandbox is quiet and over 280s when other threads run suites at the same time, so the timeout is hang detection, not a speed limit.
_zip_executable_globs: install.sh, run.sh, and the .desktop files ship executable — the same set build_zip.py stores as 0o100755. launcher.sh and ci/check.sh are templates invoked via sed/sh and ship 0o100644, so they are deliberately NOT matched by a *.sh glob.
